Uses original owned D context. No pack/approval installation in prepare.

resources.caseTimeouts: Original READ/FULL/VERIFY worker60s and original TRANSPORT worker limits; no new deadline increases.
resources.estimate: Several hours may be required, primarily154 TRANSPORT case invocations. Exact new-batch time/peak is unknown until measured; first hosted Native job1h9m4s is not a calibration estimate. Use preserved original R7 timing only as historical reference, never acceptance data.
resources.sideEffects: Local synthetic SQLite/Source fixtures, logs, raw reports and a newly built Native executable; fixedC R8 can retain substantial evidence. No production data or credentials, no PR/merge/push or remote publication during this collection proposal.
resources.dependencies: Use existing pinned Node24.15.0 and Rust toolchain1.98.1; no dependency/toolchain upgrade. If required pinned cache/tool is unavailable, report before changing environment.

stopConditions: Any source/environment/tool drift from freeze; occupied or aliased output/fixed root; unsupported context or unavailable pinned tool: refuse before acquisition.

Each command must finish with expected raw structure, complete original cases/repetitions and no unexpected failure; otherwise stop before next phase, retain stdout/stderr/partial ownership and do not retry.
Internal original tools may finish recording failed slots; do not delete failures, select low peaks or turn verification into calibration.
Unknown cleanup/ownership is retained as refusal; no blind process kill, root deletion, repair/adoption of R7 or R8, or retry.

approvalBoundaries.neededNow: Explicit authorization for these fixed-input new-implementation resource calibration and independent verification invocations, including original R8 prepare Native build/real fixture work.
approvalBoundaries.notIncluded: No numeric/profile adoption, no copying old reservations to new key, no archive/approval pin rewrite, no pack publication or production acceptance.
approvalBoundaries.neededAfterEvidence: Review exact candidates/raw/independent outputs; approve specific new values/profile installation and exact R8 pack/approval asset. Then perform existing mandatory actual-port/approved observation/actual22 CI gates.
approvalBoundaries.existingPushCI: Same continuation branch repair push and its three automatic mandatory CI jobs remain authorized. No manual rerun of old-head jobs. Changed Windows routing/layout tests need new-commit validation; exact-key Native refusal remains until qualification/profile approval. PR22 must stay unchanged.
